name: create_incident
description: Log a ticket for the caller. First call it with caller_confirmed=false to get the read-back text; after the caller agrees, call again with caller_confirmed=true. Links to a major incident automatically, and alerts a technician if colleagues report the same thing.

summary.description: One line in plain words, e.g. 'VPN disconnects every few minutes'.

details.description: What the caller described, what you tried, any error messages.

service.description: The app or system involved, if any, e.g. VPN, Slack, Gmail.

impact.description: Who is affected: just the caller, their team, their whole office, or everyone.

urgency.description: Can they still work, are they slowed down, or completely blocked?

kb_id.description: The knowledge-base article you followed, if any.

security_concern.description: True for anything security-related: phishing, a clicked link, a password typed into a strange page, unexpected login prompts, certificate warnings, possible compromise.

resolved_on_call.description: True if the problem is already fixed on this call.

caller_confirmed.description: True only after you read the summary back and the caller said yes.
